summary: Initialized projects can now run nav-map sync across repository, workflow-manifest, and URL sources. Sync selects named environments, uses auth state ids only for workflow generation, controls screenshot capture, atomically publishes the graph, writes an agent-readable latest-sync receipt, and preserves the last good graph on generation failure. A real repository test proves that adding a route and syncing again updates the generated graph.
deviations: Authenticated sync is limited to workflow projects because those manifests already provide the safe auth-state id-to-storage mapping.
Lint passed with max-lines warnings in existing large files plus the new project module; there were no lint errors.
remaining_blockers: The full goal still requires migration and stable viewer-identity hardening, lifecycle edge-case coverage, fresh-app and three-app browser proof, onboarding updates, full compatibility verification, and final audit.
